# Draft:Invasion of Anguilla

Invasion of Anguilla may refer to:
* 1745 Battle of Anguilla, when French forces attempted to seize the island from British control
* 1969 Operation Sheepskin, a British military operation aimed to restore British rule to the island, after it had declared itself an independent republic
See also
* Anguilla (island)
* Anguilla
